params.motivation: Composite scenario motivated by EMT simulation studies of IBR islanding events. Parameters (RoCoF=-6 Hz/s, phase jumps 40°/80°, ring-down 3 Hz, harmonics 5th+7th) are representative of documented IBR transient signatures. Synthetic signal at fs=10 kHz.
params.parameters: 5 s: (0-1s) IBR steady w/ 5th & 7th harmonics; (1.0s) +40 deg phase jump; (1.2-2.5s) ROCOF -6 Hz/s (60→52.8 Hz); (2.5s) +80 deg phase jump; (2.5-3.5s) 2nd-order ring-down (f_osc=3 Hz, σ=3 s⁻¹); (3.5-5s) harmonic-rich steady-state w/ impulsive noise.
params.noise: Gaussian background sigma_g=0.003 pu + non-Gaussian impulsive spikes sigma_imp=0.05 pu (p=0.0005 per sample). Note: figure caption sigma=0.05 refers to impulsive spike amplitude.
params.dynamics: Composite: phase jumps, fast RoCoF, ring-down, non-Gaussian disturbances.
